summary.text: Jarrod Ousley is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 24 since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he is the ranking minority member of the Welfare Reform and Child Welfare and Foster Care committees.

paragraphs.text: Jarrod Ousley grew up in Johnson County and attended Shawnee Mission public schools.
According to his Ballotpedia biography, he has for over 13 years owned and operated a paint contracting company.
Ousley was first elected to the Kansas House in 2014 and took office on January 12, 2015; District 24 is composed of the city of Merriam and parts of Mission and Overland Park.

For 2025 and 2026 he is assigned to the Appropriations, K-12 Education Budget, Welfare Reform, and Child Welfare and Foster Care committees, as well as the Child Welfare System Oversight, Kansas Security and State Building Construction committees.
